article_title: Quality Improvement in Surgery Combining Lean Improvement Methods with Teamwork Training: A Controlled Before-After Study.
citation: Robertson Eleanor, Morgan Lauren, New Steve, Pickering Sharon, Hadi Mohammed, Collins Gary, Rivero Arias Oliver, Griffin Damian, McCulloch Peter. (2015). Quality Improvement in Surgery Combining Lean Improvement Methods with Teamwork Training: A Controlled Before-After Study. PLoS ONE. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0138490
title: S3 combined intervention package: lean process engineering plus aviation-style CRM teamwork training with in-theatre coaching
description: The intervention combined two components delivered by an experienced specialist team over three months. Lean process engineering comprised a half-day training session for core frontline staff (11 attended) covering concepts including Muda, Poka-Yoke, Kaizen, flow, Just in time, process mapping and PDCA cycles, followed by frequent on-site coaching of staff project groups. Teamwork training comprised educational content on the psychology of human error and aviation CRM-based teamwork content (situational awareness sharing, flat hierarchy, communication protocols, checklists), delivered in three sessions (20 staff attended one each), followed by "5 days in-theatre coaching spread over 6 weeks" supporting WHO checklist completion and other non-technical skills.
requirements: Delivery by experienced specialist trainers and consultants
On-site coaching presence over the intervention period
Frontline staff participation in training sessions and project work
constraints: Observers and staff could not be blinded to study arm; the amount of external support used would be infeasible at whole-hospital scale
target_learners: operating theatre team members (nursing, surgical and anaesthetic staff)
target_learning_goals: reliable completion of the WHO surgical safety checklist
examples: In this study the package was delivered to a plastic and reconstructive surgery theatre team, with a lower-limb orthopaedic team in the same theatre suite serving as control
